observations.observation: The robotic arm moves from the left side towards the conveyor belt.
The arm positions its gripper directly above a metal part on the conveyor.
The arm descends and the gripper attempts to grasp the metal part.
The arm retracts upwards with an empty gripper, failing to pick up the part, and a red warning light on the left panel begins to flash.

summary: The robotic arm executes a smooth and stable trajectory to pick up a metal part from the conveyor belt. However, the gripper fails to secure the part, and the arm retracts empty, triggering a red warning light on the control panel.
